items.text: The payroll team has updated the effective date for the Q3 merit increases from July 15 to August 1. Employees will see the adjusted amounts in their August 31 paystubs.

Patrons can renew a library loan up to two times unless the item has been requested by another borrower. Renewals are available in person, by phone at 555-0142, or through the online catalog under My Account. Items returned after the due date accrue a fine of $0.25 per day, capped at the item's replacement cost. Reference materials and new-release DVDs are not eligible for renewal. If you believe a fine was applied in error, please speak with the circulation desk before paying it.
Please note that the Bramblewood branch will be closed on Monday, September 2 for scheduled HVAC maintenance. The book drop will remain open.

The Q2 sales report shows total revenue of $4.82 million, a 6.3% increase over Q1 but 1.1% below the same quarter last year. The enterprise segment drove most of the growth, closing 41 new accounts against a target of 35. Consumer sales were flat, largely because the spring promotion launched two weeks later than planned. Regional performance was uneven: the Northeast exceeded plan at 108%, while the Southwest finished at 92% due to two delayed distributor agreements. Management has asked the regional leads to submit recovery plans by the end of the month.

Quarterly Sales Report — Q2 FY2025

Summary

Company-wide bookings reached $4.82M, up 6.3% quarter over quarter. The enterprise segment accounted for 71% of new bookings. Gross margin held at 62%, in line with plan.

| Region | Target ($M) | Actual ($M) | Attainment |
|--------|-------------|-------------|------------|
| Northeast | 1.20 | 1.30 | 108% |
| Southeast | 0.90 | 0.85 | 94% |
| Midwest | 1.10 | 1.09 | 99% |
| Southwest | 1.05 | 0.97 | 92% |
| West | 1.30 | 1.36 | 105% |

Highlights and Risks

The enterprise segment closed 41 new accounts, six above target. Renewal rates improved to 94% from 91% in Q1. The consumer segment was flat, mainly because the spring promotion launched two weeks late.

Two distributor agreements in the Southwest slipped into Q3, deferring roughly $120K in expected bookings. The regional lead has been asked to provide a recovery plan by month end.

Outlook

Management maintains full-year guidance of $19.5M in bookings. Hiring for two open account executive roles in the Southwest is expected to close in August.

Payroll Change Request — Help Documentation

Overview

The Payroll Change Request feature lets employees and managers submit updates to tax withholding, direct deposit, and benefit deductions without paper forms.

How it works

1. The employee opens Payroll > Change Requests in the self-service portal.
2. They select a change type and enter the new details.
3. The request routes to the employee's manager, then to Payroll for approval.
4. Approved changes apply to the next open payroll run.

The portal validates routing and account numbers against the bank's checksum before submission. Rejected requests show a reason code in the employee's dashboard, and the employee can correct and resubmit.

Deadlines

Changes must be approved by 5:00 p.m. local time on the Wednesday before a pay date. Requests approved after that cutoff apply to the following period.

Support

For questions, contact payroll@meridianfoods.com or extension 4410.

Monthly stats from the Q2 sales report appendix show that the West region closed the quarter strongest, with 1.36M against a 1.30M target. The Southwest missed at 92% attainment, and the two delayed distributor agreements account for most of the shortfall. Renewal rates came in at 94% overall, up three points from Q1.

Library loan records for the past 30 days show 12,447 checkouts and 11,902 returns, leaving 545 items still out past their due date. The most requested title was 'The Cartographer's Daughter,' with 87 holds. Staff processed 214 renewals through the phone line and 1,338 through the online catalog.
